GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Four Wide first turn and worked up to 1 length Two Wide , Held Together same until the 500m when the leader raced away, trailed nearly 3 Lengths Two Wide turning and Dropped Out in Straight # worked a bit early
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down equal 4th 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide running 3rd as they turned, Lost Ground in Straight # Wide early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , drove Through and led rails 800m, Headed soon after Straightening Up and battled late to miss placing # battled late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keen in the lead. Laid out under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Went Forward to Lead on fence by a long neck, Held Together up front & led jointly turning, Headed 400m and dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Cast its near fore plate on arrival at the barriers. Farrier reattached the plate. underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to race. Rider reported he had not intended to lead but allowed it to stride forward after beginning well and obtained a relatively easy lead. Raced keenly early stages.]] # led/weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported it was not his intention to lead, that after beginning well, he allowed his mount to stride and when runners to his inside did not improve, he was able to obtain a relatively easy lead. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths ? Restrained Crossed Inside Settled Down 6th/5th Inside 5 Lengths and Inside winner, Under Pressure x 500! Turning for home awkwardly couldn't finish off - # Prefer To See Again
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Lost Ground in Straight # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 1400m improved onto heels and when steadied, raced keenly for a short distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Restrained and drifted back, Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Restrained from the wide gate to obtain cover.

Rdr stated was able to obtain a forward position early-said then attempted to obtain lead leaving 1200m, however the then leader, held position & the middle stages were run quicker than preferred-added when another runner improved to outside at 800m, obliged to pressure mount to keep in contact-said approaching h/turn, that runner shifted out, obliged to race wider & inconvenienced by laying out in home straight. Rdr said mount then began to feel pressure of race & in not being comfortable with gelding’s action did not pressure mount from 200m.  Post race vet exam no abs.
